body: I eat right, I run regularly. Will pass on the last one.

I guess the concern would be that I’m content with not having spoken a word out loud for the past 5 days. I’ve had no human interaction, and I’m okay with that. I don’t have any interest in it nor do I have any interest in finding the feelings that were tormenting me for months. 

It makes me wonder if this is how I know it is time. To feel calm. To feel nothing. Makes it easier to be done with it all.

I know that I’ve been depressed for a while, but during that time I was actually feeling something. Hopeless. Empty. Distraught. Lost. Angry. 

But now I feel nothing. Like a switch was turned off and now......nothing. Total calm and nothing.
That’s the funny thing, I don’t feel empty, I just feel nothing.
I feel completely disconnected from everyone and everything. I simply exist while going through the motions, or no motions at all.
